title: Happy sheep
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fe3ff' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fe3ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- soft glow behind sheep -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- woolly body: cluster of puffy circles -->
  <g fill='#eaf4ff'>
    <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='48' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='9'/>
  </g>

  <!-- shading on lower wool -->
  <g fill='#bcd6f2'>
    <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='10'/>
  </g>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#4a5a78'/>
  <rect x='57' y='72' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#4a5a78'/>
  <rect x='36' y='82' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2f3a52'/>
  <rect x='57' y='82' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2f3a52'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#3a4a68'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#52678c'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='43' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a4a68' transform='rotate(-20 34 43)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='43' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a4a68' transform='rotate(20 66 43)'/>

  <!-- eyes: happy closed arcs -->
  <path d='M43 45 q3 -4 6 0' stroke='#8fe3ff' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M51 45 q3 -4 6 0' stroke='#8fe3ff' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#ff9db0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#ff9db0' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- nose + smile -->
  <path d='M48 50 q2 2 4 0' stroke='#8fe3ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 54 q3 3 6 0' stroke='#8fe3ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- top tuft -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='6' fill='#eaf4ff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='4.5' fill='#eaf4ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='35' r='4.5' fill='#eaf4ff'/>
</svg>
